summary: Learn effective approaches to poverty reduction in our Social Protection Systems Training Course. Empower yourself to make a difference in society today.
lede: Social protection systems use tools such as cash transfers and public works to address poverty and household vulnerability. Designed for professionals who plan, deliver, or evaluate support programs, this course develops skills in poverty measurement and beneficiary targeting, cash-transfer design, and digital delivery and monitoring, with practice in adapting programs to shocks.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating national safety nets and poverty alleviation initiatives.
modules: Foundations of Social Protection and Poverty Measurement
Designing Cash Transfers and Public Works
The Graduation Approach and Economic Inclusion
Financing, Fiscal Space, and Political Economy
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic social policy, international development principles, or public administration. No advanced statistical coding experience is required, but familiarity with basic data analysis and spreadsheet software is recommended.
